migrations.needle: test('4459两弱化都失败才确定maxHP三分一理论吸取，全部成功不吸；一成功一失败真实记录待答而不猜补偿，免疫不补抽',()=>{const s=make(base,{soul:1672,omit:true,hp:1000});timer(s,1,'免异常');timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let o=turn(s,920031);assert.equal(o.randomStatusEvents.length,2);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(sum(o,'percent'),0);const q=make(base,{soul:1672,omit:true,hp:1000});q.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;o=turn(q,920031);assert.equal(o.randomStatusEvents.length,2);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingTugaMixedStatuses.question,'Q-N20-4459-001');assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingTugaMixedStatuses.result.filter(x=>x.applied).length,1);});
